source.author: lucan
source.text: Nec piger ignis erat per stuppea vincula perque Manantes cera tabulas: et tempore eodem Transtraque nautarum summique arsere ceruchi.
source.text_original: Nec piger ignis erat per stuppea vincula perque / Manantes cera tabulas: et tempore eodem / Transtraque nautarum summique arsere ceruchi.
source.text_english: Nor was the fire sluggish as it spread through the tow ropes and through the wax that dripped from the planks; and at the same time the benches of the sailors and the topmost mast also blazed.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: constitit ut longo moles non pervia ponto puppis, et ut tenues subiere latentia cerae lumina, picturae varios superaddit honores.
reuse.text_original: constitit ut longo moles non pervia ponto / puppis, et ut tenues subiere latentia cerae / lumina, picturae varios superaddit honores.
reuse.text_english: It was established that the bulk of the ship, impassable by the long sea, stood firm, and that the hidden lights were taken up beneath the thin wax; he adds to the painting various honors.
